evidence.quote: Thus, I think we can afford to proceed more cautiously with further cuts.
Over time, I still think it will likely be appropriate to move the policy rate toward a more neutral stance.
I continue to view the risks to achieving the two sides of the Federal Reserve's dual mandate of price stability and maximum employment as being roughly in balance.
I continue to see inflation as gradually—if unevenly—returning over time to our goal of 2 percent in a sustainable manner.
since September, the labor market has been somewhat more resilient, while inflation has been stickier than I assumed at that time.
